Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style

Class SldGeometry

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.SldGeometry
public abstract class SldGeometry extends Object
GML 2 geometry representation for use in OGC spatial filter predicates.

Instances are created exclusively via the static factory methods on this class and passed to the spatial filter factories in OgcFilters (e.g. OgcFilters.bbox(java.lang.String, io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.SldGeometry), OgcFilters.intersects(java.lang.String, io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.SldGeometry), OgcFilters.dWithin(java.lang.String, io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.SldGeometry, double, java.lang.String)). Each factory method produces an object that serializes to the corresponding GML 2 XML fragment when embedded in an SLD 1.0 <ogc:Filter>.

All coordinate arrays use interleaved x,y pairs in the order the spatial reference system expects (longitude, latitude for geographic CRS such as EPSG:4326).

Usage


 import static io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.OgcFilters.*;
 import static io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.SldGeometry.*;

 // Bounding-box filter
 OgcFilter worldBbox = bbox("the_geom", envelope(-180, -90, 180, 90, "EPSG:4326"));

 // Point intersection
 OgcFilter atOrigin = intersects("the_geom", point(0, 0, "EPSG:4326"));

 // Line crossing
 OgcFilter crossLine = crosses("the_geom",
     lineString("EPSG:4326", -74.0, 40.7, -73.9, 40.8));

 // Polygon within
 OgcFilter inSquare = within("the_geom",
     polygon("EPSG:4326", 0, 0, 10, 0, 10, 10, 0, 10, 0, 0));
Since:
1.0.0

    • envelope

      public static SldGeometry envelope(double minX, double minY, double maxX, double maxY, String srsName)
      Creates a GML 2 <gml:Box> envelope for use in BBOX spatial filters.

      Generates: 

      
 <gml:Box srsName="EPSG:4326">
   <gml:coordinates>minX,minY maxX,maxY</gml:coordinates>
 </gml:Box>
      Parameters:
      minX - western boundary (minimum X / minimum longitude in geographic CRS)
      minY - southern boundary (minimum Y / minimum latitude in geographic CRS)
      maxX - eastern boundary (maximum X / maximum longitude in geographic CRS)
      maxY - northern boundary (maximum Y / maximum latitude in geographic CRS)
      srsName - the spatial reference system identifier (e.g. "EPSG:4326"); must not be null or blank
      Returns:
      a SldGeometry that serializes to a <gml:Box> element

    • envelope

      public static SldGeometry envelope(double minX, double minY, double maxX, double maxY)
      Creates a GML 2 <gml:Box> envelope without an explicit SRS.

      minY - southern boundary
      maxX - eastern boundary
      maxY - northern boundary
      Returns:

      public static SldGeometry lineString(String srsName, double... coords)
      Creates a GML 2 <gml:LineString> geometry from interleaved x,y coordinate pairs.

      Returns:

    • polygon

      public static SldGeometry polygon(String srsName, double... shellCoords)
      Creates a GML 2 <gml:Polygon> geometry from exterior ring coordinates.

      Only the exterior (outer) ring is supported; interior rings (holes) are not modelled. The ring must be closed — the last coordinate pair must equal the first.

      Generates: 

      
 <gml:Polygon srsName="EPSG:4326">
   <gml:outerBoundaryIs>
     <gml:LinearRing>
       <gml:coordinates>0,0 10,0 10,10 0,10 0,0</gml:coordinates>
     </gml:LinearRing>
   </gml:outerBoundaryIs>
 </gml:Polygon>
      Parameters:
      srsName - the spatial reference system identifier (e.g. "EPSG:4326")
      shellCoords - interleaved x,y coordinate pairs for the exterior ring: x1, y1, x2, y2, …, x1, y1. The ring must close (first coordinate == last coordinate).
      Returns:
      a SldGeometry that serializes to a <gml:Polygon> element

    • multiPoint

      public static SldGeometry multiPoint(String srsName, double... coords)
      Creates a GML 2 <gml:MultiPoint> geometry from interleaved x,y coordinate pairs.

      Each consecutive x,y pair becomes one <gml:pointMember> inside the collection. Generates: 

      
 <gml:MultiPoint srsName="EPSG:4326">
   <gml:pointMember><gml:Point><gml:coordinates>x1,y1</gml:coordinates></gml:Point></gml:pointMember>
   <gml:pointMember><gml:Point><gml:coordinates>x2,y2</gml:coordinates></gml:Point></gml:pointMember>
 </gml:MultiPoint>
      Parameters:
      srsName - the spatial reference system identifier (e.g. "EPSG:4326")
      coords - interleaved x,y coordinate pairs: x1, y1, x2, y2, …. Must contain an even number of values.
      Returns:
      a SldGeometry that serializes to a <gml:MultiPoint> element

    • multiLineString

      public static SldGeometry multiLineString(String srsName, double[]... lineCoords)
      Creates a GML 2 <gml:MultiLineString> geometry.

      Each inner array represents one line member and must contain interleaved x,y pairs. Generates one <gml:lineStringMember> per inner array.

      Parameters:
      srsName - the spatial reference system identifier (e.g. "EPSG:4326")
      lineCoords - each inner double[] contains the interleaved x,y coordinate pairs for one line segment (at least 4 values: two points)
      Returns:
      a SldGeometry that serializes to a <gml:MultiLineString> element

    • multiPolygon

      public static SldGeometry multiPolygon(String srsName, double[]... polygonRings)
      Creates a GML 2 <gml:MultiPolygon> geometry (exterior rings only).

      Each inner array represents one polygon exterior ring and must contain interleaved x,y pairs. Interior rings (holes) are not modelled. Each ring must close (first coordinate == last coordinate). Generates one <gml:polygonMember> per inner array.

      Parameters:
      srsName - the spatial reference system identifier (e.g. "EPSG:4326")
      polygonRings - each inner double[] contains the interleaved x,y exterior ring coordinate pairs for one polygon (must close)
      Returns:
      a SldGeometry that serializes to a <gml:MultiPolygon> element

      Returns:

    • geometryCollection

      public static SldGeometry geometryCollection(SldGeometry... members)
      Creates a GML 2 <gml:GeometryCollection> from heterogeneous member geometries.

      Any mix of point, line, polygon, multi-*, or nested collection geometries may be supplied. Each member is wrapped in a <gml:geometryMember> element. The collection itself carries no SRS — each member geometry carries its own.

      Parameters:
      members - the member geometries; must not be null or empty
      Returns:
      a SldGeometry that serializes to a <gml:GeometryCollection> element
